name: firmador-esign — API SIFEN (Go)
install: cd /agent/repos/firmador-esign && go mod download && go build ./...

terminals.name: esign-api
terminals.description: API SIFEN multi-tenant (cmd/server) en :8080. Arranca solo si están los secretos ESIGN_ORDS_BASE, ESIGN_SERVICE_TOKEN y ESIGN_MASTER_KEY; si no, imprime cómo configurarlos.
terminals.command: cd /agent/repos/firmador-esign && if [ -n "$ESIGN_ORDS_BASE" ] && [ -n "$ESIGN_SERVICE_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$ESIGN_MASTER_KEY" ]; then go run ./cmd/server; else echo 'Faltan secretos (ESIGN_ORDS_BASE, ESIGN_SERVICE_TOKEN, ESIGN_MASTER_KEY). Configuralos en el panel de Secrets y reinicia esta terminal para levantar la API SIFEN en :8080. El endpoint publico es GET /v1/health.'; fi
